sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: HSDPA HARQ：重傳機會與平均交付時間
related.titleEn: HSDPA HARQ: retries and mean delivery time
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付物能重現 250000 symbol/s 與 62500 symbol/s，保留失敗情境且每個通過判定有明確門檻；需分開列出模型未涵蓋的實際系統驗證。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: The artifacts must reproduce 250000 symbol/s and 62500 symbol/s, preserve failing scenarios and attach a threshold to each pass decision; list actual-system validation outside this model separately.
related.difference: 能推導並解釋4.44444444444 ms與5.33333333333 ms，建立harq_attempts.csv、級數尾項、回饋時間表，並完成以下驗收：5 ms平均門檻下第二組失敗；平均通過仍不能保證尾延遲或有上限重傳的成功率。
related.differenceEn: Derive and explain 4.44444444444 ms and 5.33333333333 ms; create harq_attempts.csv, series-tail checks and feedback timings; apply this acceptance decision: The second case fails a5 ms mean limit; a passing mean does not establish tail latency or bounded-retry reliability.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 從原理 固定chip rate下，符元率與spreading factor成反比；10log10(SF)是理想處理增益指標，不含多使用者干擾。 展開基準式 4000000/16；逐步記錄中間量與單位，先手算再用計算器或Python重算。接著用不同表示法交叉檢查：將各符元率乘SF回到4 Mchip/s；畫每個符元含16或64 chip的區塊。 將兩條推導一起存入 wcdma_chips.csv、相關峰紀錄、SF速率表。
從原理 本課用獨立失敗機率p的簡化停止等待模型E[N]=1/(1-p)；實際軟合併使各次失敗率相關，須另外量測。 展開基準式 4/(1-0.1)；逐步記錄中間量與單位，先手算再用計算器或Python重算。接著用不同表示法交叉檢查：把前十項幾何級數與解析極限比較，保留未加總尾項；不要把p直接當平均重傳次數。 將兩條推導一起存入 harq_attempts.csv、級數尾項、回饋時間表。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Starting from At fixed chip rate, symbol rate scales inversely with spreading factor;10log10(SF) is an ideal processing-gain indicator excluding multiuser interference., expand baseline expression 4000000/16; record intermediate values and units, calculate manually, then repeat with a calculator or Python. Use this independent representation: Multiply symbol rate by SF to recover4 Mchip/s and draw16/64-chip symbol blocks. Save both derivations with wcdma_chips.csv, correlation-peak records and SF/rate table.

Starting from Use a simplified stop-and-wait model with independent failure probabilityp and E[N]=1/(1-p); real soft combining changes conditional failure rates., expand baseline expression 4/(1-0.1); record intermediate values and units, calculate manually, then repeat with a calculator or Python. Use this independent representation: Compare ten terms of the geometric series with its analytic limit and retain the tail; p is not the mean retry count. Save both derivations with harq_attempts.csv, series-tail checks and feedback timings.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: 5G NR 波束掃描：搜尋時間與遮蔽恢復
related.titleEn: 5G NR beam sweep: search time and blockage recovery
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付物能重現 250000 symbol/s 與 62500 symbol/s，保留失敗情境且每個通過判定有明確門檻；需分開列出模型未涵蓋的實際系統驗證。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: The artifacts must reproduce 250000 symbol/s and 62500 symbol/s, preserve failing scenarios and attach a threshold to each pass decision; list actual-system validation outside this model separately.
related.difference: 能推導並解釋1280 microsecond與320 microsecond，建立beam_candidates.csv、掃描時間軸、漏選反例，並完成以下驗收：500 microsecond搜尋預算只容16波束；必須另設粗選失敗回退，不得把時間通過等同覆蓋通過。
related.differenceEn: Derive and explain 1280 microsecond and 320 microsecond; create beam_candidates.csv, sweep timeline and shortlist counterexample; apply this acceptance decision: Only16 beams meet a500 microsecond budget; add fallback for shortlist misses because timing acceptance is not coverage acceptance.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 從原理 固定chip rate下，符元率與spreading factor成反比；10log10(SF)是理想處理增益指標，不含多使用者干擾。 展開基準式 4000000/16；逐步記錄中間量與單位，先手算再用計算器或Python重算。接著用不同表示法交叉檢查：將各符元率乘SF回到4 Mchip/s；畫每個符元含16或64 chip的區塊。 將兩條推導一起存入 wcdma_chips.csv、相關峰紀錄、SF速率表。
從原理 序列式波束搜尋時間等於候選數乘每次觀測時間；減少候選可能漏掉最佳方向，不能只最小化時間。 展開基準式 64*20；逐步記錄中間量與單位，先手算再用計算器或Python重算。接著用不同表示法交叉檢查：列方向索引與接收品質，驗證每個候選恰觀測一次；測試最佳波束不在粗選集合的反例。 將兩條推導一起存入 beam_candidates.csv、掃描時間軸、漏選反例。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Starting from At fixed chip rate, symbol rate scales inversely with spreading factor;10log10(SF) is an ideal processing-gain indicator excluding multiuser interference., expand baseline expression 4000000/16; record intermediate values and units, calculate manually, then repeat with a calculator or Python. Use this independent representation: Multiply symbol rate by SF to recover4 Mchip/s and draw16/64-chip symbol blocks. Save both derivations with wcdma_chips.csv, correlation-peak records and SF/rate table.

Starting from Sequential beam-search duration is candidate count times observation time; fewer candidates may miss the best direction., expand baseline expression 64*20; record intermediate values and units, calculate manually, then repeat with a calculator or Python. Use this independent representation: List direction IDs and quality, observing each once; include a counterexample whose optimum lies outside the shortlist. Save both derivations with beam_candidates.csv, sweep timeline and shortlist counterexample.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
